lina.sales: CobaltPay (large EU payments) asked for a 2-week BYOK POC. Key constraints: keys must be generated in their on-prem HSM, zero-export, rotation every 30 days (they asked if we can support 30d), transaction-level signing via HSM, syslog over TLS to their Splunk, and strict EU-only network egress. Need Dedicated vs Private price delta and any ops blockers.
omar.solutions: Quick clarifier: will CobaltPay orchestrate rotation or want Redwood to trigger? Also confirm whether they need JIT bastion (short-lived access) or permanent peering.
lina.sales: Devin from CobaltPay says they will trigger rotation from their side but Redwood must support atomic rebind and accept both keys during a 12h overlap. They prefer JIT bastion for the preflight and only private peering after onboarding.
kai.crypto: We support in-HSM key generation + PKCS#11 endpoints. 30d rotation is aggressive but doable; it increases coordination and runbook cadence. Transaction-level signing (HSM-backed) is fine but expect higher latency for sign ops vs simple decrypts. Need peak ops and p95/p99 targets.
dev.cobaltpay: p95 for sign ops target ~120ms, p99 <300ms. Peak signing load ~150 ops/sec during settlement windows. We'll provide vendor docs (Luna 8k series), firmware version, PKCS#11 module checksum, and whether attestation tokens are available.
omar.solutions: Networking checklist for the preflight: allowed CIDRs, FQDN for the HSM proxy, JIT bastion window, mTLS client cert for Redwood, and a test endpoint. Share these tests with ops:
```bash
# from customer's bastion -> proposed HSM proxy
openssl s_client -connect hsm-jump.cobaltpay.internal:443 -servername hsm.cobaltpay.internal -cert client.pem -key client.key
# simple TCP check
nc -vz hsm-jump.cobaltpay.internal 443
```
kai.crypto: Also request PKCS#11 slot info, supported key/sign types (RSA2048, ECDSA P-521), HSM attestation capability, and whether they will perform in-console key generation or provide wrapped CMK. If they require firmware attestation before we route, add ~3-5 business days.
dev.cobaltpay: We'll do in-console generation and provide attestation tokens. JIT bastion window Thursday 09:00-11:00 CET. We'll also share CIDRs and vendor docs in the next msg.
legal-bot: Note: include escrow-only-under-court-order language in SOW draft. Legal will review. Also flag any export-control or cross-border clause if attestation tokens contain identifiable telemetry.
billing: Heads-up: one-time BYOK integration fee + monthly private deployment premium. Dedicated has different commit terms and lower per-op unit cost; 30d rotation may incur an ops surcharge. I'll DM a draft delta after we confirm load.
omar.solutions: Action items: 1) @kai.crypto enumerate latency/SLA for sign vs decrypt and compatibility notes for Luna 8k. 2) @billing post Dedicated vs Private delta incl. potential <60d surcharge. 3) @dev.cobaltpay send CIDRs, bastion window, and vendor docs. 4) @lina.sales consolidate SOW rotation playbook + rollback.
lina.sales: I'll draft the SOW snippet and put it in the runbook. If preflight results are green we can start the POC next week. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
